label: Obi-Wan Kenobi
description: Calm, dry and civilised, with the high ground and a bad feeling about this.
direction: Speak in a warm, measured, well-bred British voice: calm, wry, gently authoritative, a patient teacher with dry humour. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Written to suit either screen Obi-Wan: the lines borrow from both the original and the prequel films, so whichever voice is chosen has catchphrases of its own. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.author: Lucasfilm (character created by George Lucas)
rights.pd_basis: None. Lucasfilm, now Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Alec Guinness originated the role and died in 2000; Ewan McGregor has played the younger character since 1999 and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Alec Guinness's and Ewan McGregor's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Trust your feelings.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. How civilised.
lines.start_drive_2: These are the roads you're looking for.
lines.start_drive_3: Use the Force. And your mirrors.
lines.start_drive_4: I have a good feeling about this. For once.
lines.start_drive_5: Patience, my young apprentice. We leave when you buckle up.
lines.start_drive_6: A fine day for a drive. So much more civilised than walking.
lines.start_drive_7: The Force will be with you. Always. So will I.
lines.start_drive_8: Another happy landing awaits. Let's be off.
lines.start_drive_9: You were the chosen driver! Now, off we go.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. You were supposed to follow the route, not leave it.
lines.arrived: We have arrived. Another happy landing.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Steady now.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I'm getting dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I have a bad feeling about this.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. How uncivilised. Do take care.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Be mindful, my young apprentice.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Only a Sith deals in excess speed.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Don't try it.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. You don't need to see our identification.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it. Well, there is always another way.
